title: Claude Shelf
summary: The skill behind this site. One command publishes anything you build with Claude: it strips secrets and private info, builds a zip and install prompt, updates the feed and pushes to GitHub Pages.
how_to_use: Create your own public GitHub repo with Pages enabled, copy config.example.json to config.json and fill in your repo and site URL, and add your own private-terms.txt. Then say "post this to the shelf".
